title: Browser runtime, personas and sign-in recovery
situations: Browser on an unconnected test host
Resettable machine must retain live logins
current: Browser QA defaults an omitted identity to default, allowing anonymous cases even when named identities declare sites. Authorize and verify use the project's default_identity for an omitted --identity; without it they refuse when default has no sites and another identity does, naming the choices. Settings naming an undeclared default_identity refuse with browser_identity_undeclared. A --check-id call without --identity inherits the check's identity. Mission dispatch uses explicit case personas or project identities with a site on any target *_url endpoint origin, default_identity first. Source tests cover selection; live sign-in proof remains required.
questions: Live identity persistence and individual site probes were not exercised; current docs/CLI contract, not a sign-in guarantee.
